rules.accepted_credit_types: CME as required by NCCPA; must maintain national certification through recertification mechanisms recognized by the Board
rules.alternatives: Requirement is NCCPA CME plus national certification (Board also recognizes other national certifying organizations it publishes).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial licensure: 3 hours child abuse recognition and reporting; prescribers: 4 hours (2 pain management/addiction + 2 opioid prescribing) once, within 1 year of licensure (ABC-MAP).

topics.who: All PAs; Board-approved provider; part of the NCCPA CME
PAs with prescriptive authority holding or using a DEA registration: pain management, identification of addiction or opioid prescribing/dispensing

rules.notes: Biennial renewal. Supervised by the State Board of Medicine; PAs working with DOs are licensed by the State Board of Osteopathic Medicine (second rule).
